newsitem.title: GERMANY: Henkel sees H2 at least as good as H1.
newsitem.headline: Henkel sees H2 at least as good as H1.

text.p: German speciality chemicals group Henkel KGaA on Tuesday posted a 10 percent rise in pre-tax profit and a 22 percent rise in sales in the first half of 1997 and predicted sales and earnings would develop at least as well in the second half.
Henkel said it expected full-year 1997 results to be well above 1996 levels.

That forecast applied even excluding the 1.3 billion-mark income from the sale of its 16.1 percent stake in metals company Degussa AG and including the increase in financing costs resulting from the acquistion of U.S.-based adhesives maker Loctite LOC.N, Henkel said.
The first-half pre-tax profit figure does not include proceeds from the sale of the Degussa stake. Henkel said it would use the 1.3 billion marks to continue strengthening its core activities.
In 1996, group net profit rose 5.5 percent to 515 million marks.
